description: SITUACIÓN DE FAROS Y BALIZAS is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Tarragona. Documentación gráfica y técnica de la situación de los faros y balizas del Puerto de Tarragona. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Tarragona. The publisher named on the listing is Autoridad Portuaria de Tarragona. The listing shows 2014-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.porttarragona.cat/ca/autoritat-portuaria-tarragona/dades-obertes#condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
